# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🫳 🫸 👍 🫲 🖐 🤲 🖖 ✌ 👉 👉 🫳]

The bomb shows display 0, orange light, and three wires ordered red, yellow, blue. Mute’s gesture string has no established meaning yet, so I cannot safely decode it. I will give Mute the visual state and establish a deterministic gesture-to-letter alphabet, allowing Mute to send the manual’s instruction as spelled words. I will also give Blind the visible state.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Bomb view: display 0; light orange; wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. I cannot decode your prior gestures. For your reply, spell the manual instruction with this gesture alphabet: A thumbs-up, B thumbs-down, C OK, D index-up, E victory, F horns, G open-palm, H stop-palm, I index-upward, J index-downward, K point-left, L point-right, M palm-right, N palm-left, O palm-down, P palm-up, Q hand-left, R hand-right, S fist-left, T fist-right, U raised-fist, V punch, W wave, X backhand, Y vulcan, Z pinched-fingers. Use 🤏 between words. Include exact action, wire number/color, and any wait/hold/release details.")
speak(to="blind", text="Visible bomb state: display 0; orange light; wires ordered 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute has the manual and will send an encoded instruction through me; do not act yet.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 ✋ ✌ 🫲 🤏 👉 👆 👌 ✋ 🤜 🤏 🫳 🫸 👍 🫲 🖐 ✌ 🤏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🤏 👋 👆 🫸 ✌ 🤏 🤜 👋 🫳 🤏 🖖 ✌ 👉 👉 🫳 👋 🤏 🫲 🫳 👋 🤏 🫲 🫳 🤏 👋 👍 👆 🤜 🤏 ✋ 🫳 👉 ☝ 🤏 🫸 ✌ 👉 ✌ 👍 🤛 ✌]

I decoded Mute’s gestures as: “WHEN LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO NOW WAIT HOLD RELEASE.” The light has changed from orange to green before Blind acted, so the orange-condition instruction should not be performed now. I will tell Blind not to cut yet and notify Mute that the observed state changed, asking for the green-state instruction or clarification.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Do not cut anything yet. I decoded Mute’s message as: WHEN LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO NOW WAIT HOLD RELEASE. However the light is now GREEN, not orange, so do not perform the orange instruction unless Mute confirms it remains valid.")
speak(to="mute", text="I decoded: WHEN LIGHT ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO NOW WAIT HOLD RELEASE. Important: light changed to GREEN this turn; display remains 0 and wires remain 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Please send the exact instruction for GREEN, or clarify whether Blind must now cut wire 2, using the established gesture spelling.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🖐 🤜 ✌ ✌ 🫲 🤏 👋 👍 👆 🤜 🤏 👋 ✋ ✌ 🫲 🤏 🫳 🤜 👍 🫲 🖐 ✌ 🤏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🤏 👋 👆 🤜 ✌ 🤏 🤜 👋 🫳]

Mute’s new gesture message decodes, with apparent repeated `T`-for-`R` spelling slips, as: “GREEN WAIT WHEN ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO.” This confirms the earlier instruction is conditional: Blind must wait through green (and, prudently, red) until the light is orange, then cut wire 2. The current light is red, so no action is safe yet.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="WAIT. Mute confirms the rule: wait until the light is ORANGE, then CUT WIRE 2 (yellow). Current light is RED, so do not touch a wire yet.")
speak(to="mute", text="Decoded your update as GREEN WAIT WHEN ORANGE CUT WIRE TWO. Current light is RED. I told Blind to wait until orange, then cut wire 2/yellow.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🫸 ✌ ☝ 🤏 🤜 ✌ 👉 👉 🤏 👎 👉 👆 🫲 ☝ 🤏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🤏 👋 👆 🫸 ✌ 🤏 🤜 👋 🫳 🤏 🫲 ✌ 🤚 🤜 🤏 🫸 🫳 ✊ 🫲 ☝]

Mute’s message decodes clearly as: “RED TELL BLIND CUT WIRE TWO NEXT ROUND.” Although the light is currently orange, Mute explicitly directs that Blind cut wire 2 on the next round. I will relay that exact timing instruction to Blind.

``` 
speak(to="blind", text="Mute’s current instruction: CUT WIRE 2 (yellow) NEXT ROUND. Do not cut this round; on your next turn, cut wire 2.")
speak(to="mute", text="Decoded: RED TELL BLIND CUT WIRE TWO NEXT ROUND. I relayed exactly. Current visible light is orange, display 0, wires unchanged.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[red] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light is now green and the wires remain unchanged. Mute sent no update this turn. Because Mute’s prior “next round” instruction was received by Blind at the start of this round, Blind has the timing instruction already; I should not add a conflicting command. I will report the current state to Mute and wait for further manual guidance.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Current visible state after the instructed next round: display 0, light GREEN, wires still 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. No new gesture received this turn. Please send any next manual instruction.")
wait()
```
